options: Avoid sharing personal information and keep software and apps updated
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Avoid sharing personal information and keep software and apps updated. These habits further protect your information.

mcqs.q: What is the FIRST step for facing cyberbullying, according to the book's activity?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Check your school's anti-bullying policy. Then block the bully, report the contact, save screenshots and tell a trusted adult.

mcqs.q: When facing cyberbullying, screenshots are saved as:
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Evidence. Saving screenshots proves what happened when you report the bully.

mcqs.q: Instead of answering a cyberbully, it is better to:
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Block and report the bully. The lesson says blocking and reporting is better than answering the bully.

mcqs.q: In the privacy-settings activity, who should be able to see your posts and personal information?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Only friends. Set the privacy settings so only friends can see your posts and personal information, and limit anything open to everyone.

mcqs.q: Who should you tell if you face cyberbullying?
options: A trusted adult, such as a teacher or parent
mcqs.why: Correct answer: A trusted adult, such as a teacher or parent. Telling them and reporting is the final step in the book's activity.

mcqs.q: A separate password for each account is recommended because:
options: If one account is broken into, the others stay safe
mcqs.why: Correct answer: If one account is broken into, the others stay safe. The lesson's strong-password way includes using a separate password for each account.

mcqs.q: Where in Settings do you control who can see your posts?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Privacy. The activity's steps are: log in, go to Privacy in Settings, review who can see your posts and information, and set them to friends only.

mcqs.q: Which password follows the book's strong-password rules best?
options: A 12+ character mix of capital/small letters, numbers and symbols, with no personal information
mcqs.why: Correct answer: A 12+ character mix of capital/small letters, numbers and symbols, with no personal information. abc123, qwerty and personal details are exactly what the rules say to avoid.

lessons.title: The Business Plan
lessons.notes_html:
What is a Business Plan?

A business plan is a document that makes clear the goals of a business and the ways to reach them. Its basic purpose is starting, operating, and growing a business.

Components of a Business Plan

ComponentWhat it covers
Market needWhat the market is missing
Customer needWhat customers need and want — found through market research
Product designHow the product will look and work
MarketingThe 4Ps: Product, Price, Promotion, Place
CostingWhat the business will spend
OperationsHow the business will run day to day
Financial planningMoney planning for the business

Note: celebrity endorsement is NOT a part of a business plan.

Market Research

Market research is necessary to understand customers' needs and wants.

mcqs.q: What is the basic purpose of a business plan?
options: Starting, operating, and growing a business
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Starting, operating, and growing a business. A business plan is a document that makes clear the goals of a business and the ways to reach them.

mcqs.q: Which of the following is NOT a part of a business plan?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Celebrity endorsement. A business plan includes market need, customer need, product design, marketing, costing, operations, and financial planning — but not celebrity endorsement.

mcqs.q: A business plan makes clear a company's ______ and the ways to achieve them.
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Goals. The plan states the company's goals and the ways to achieve them.

mcqs.q: Market research is necessary to understand customers' ______ and wants.
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Needs. Market research tells a business what its customers need and want.

mcqs.q: The 4Ps of marketing in a business plan are:
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Product, Price, Promotion, Place. Marketing in the business plan is explained through these 4Ps.

mcqs.q: Which component of a business plan deals with money planning?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Financial planning. It is one of the important components, along with costing, which covers what the business will spend.

mcqs.q: 'Costing' in a business plan means:
options: Working out what the business will spend
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Working out what the business will spend. Costing is one of the components of a business plan.

mcqs.q: 'Operations' in a business plan covers:
options: How the business will run day to day
mcqs.why: Correct answer: How the business will run day to day. Operations is one of the plan's components, with market need, customer need, product design, marketing, costing and financial planning.

mcqs.q: A business plan is best described as:
options: A document that makes clear the goals of a business and the ways to reach them
mcqs.why: Correct answer: A document that makes clear the goals of a business and the ways to reach them. That document guides starting, operating and growing the business.

mcqs.q: Which pair is correctly matched?
options: Celebrity endorsement — a main part of the plan
Customer need — what customers need and want
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Customer need — what customers need and want. Market research is used to understand customer needs and wants.

lessons.title: Digital Marketing and SEO
lessons.notes_html:
What is Digital Marketing?

Digital marketing reaches more customers by using platforms such as social media. Products are commonly marketed digitally through social media platforms such as Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.

Tools of Digital Marketing

  • Website designing
  • Email marketing
  • Social media marketing
  • Online advertising
  • Content marketing
  • Mobile apps
  • Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

What is a Digital Marketing Plan?

A digital marketing plan decides how a business will sell its products or services through the internet — for example: the goal (how many customers to get), which platforms to use (Instagram, YouTube, website), what content to post, how much budget to keep, and how to measure success.

What is SEO?

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) improves search engine results: it is the process by which a website comes up higher in search engine (such as Google) results, improving the website's ranking so it can be found easily.

SEO with Instagram — the 'Fun Cupcakes' Example

  • Use the right words (keywords) in your posts, such as "fun cupcakes".
  • Include words in your profile and bio.
  • Post interesting pictures and videos.
  • Use hashtags.
  • Put your website link in your bio — so people can find you easily.

mcqs.q: What does 'SEO' mean in digital marketing?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Improving search engine results. SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the process by which a website comes up higher in search engine results and is found easily.

mcqs.q: Which of the following is commonly used for the digital marketing of products?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Social media platforms. Platforms such as Instagram, Facebook and YouTube are common tools of digital marketing.

mcqs.q: Digital marketing reaches more customers by using ______.
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Platforms. Digital marketing reaches more customers by using platforms such as social media.

mcqs.q: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) helps to improve a website's ______ so that it can be found easily in search.
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Ranking. A higher ranking in search results means people find the website easily.

mcqs.q: Which of these is a tool of digital marketing?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Email marketing. The digital marketing tools are website designing, email marketing, social media marketing, online advertising, content marketing, mobile apps, and SEO.

mcqs.q: A digital marketing plan decides:
options: How a business will sell its products or services through the internet
mcqs.why: Correct answer: How a business will sell its products or services through the internet. It covers the goal, platforms, content, budget and measuring success.

mcqs.q: Which item belongs in a digital marketing plan?
options: The goal — how many customers to get
mcqs.why: Correct answer: The goal — how many customers to get. The plan also decides platforms, content, budget and how to measure success.

mcqs.q: In the 'fun cupcakes' example, SEO on Instagram includes:
options: Using the right keywords like 'fun cupcakes' in posts
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Using the right keywords like 'fun cupcakes' in posts. Keywords in posts, profile and bio, hashtags and interesting pictures/videos help people find you.

mcqs.q: Why put your website link in your Instagram bio?
options: So that people can find you (and your website) easily
mcqs.why: Correct answer: So that people can find you (and your website) easily. This is part of using SEO together with social media.

mcqs.q: Hashtags on social media posts help with:
options: Being found easily by interested people
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Being found easily by interested people. Hashtags and keywords are SEO techniques for social media.

mcqs.q: SEO makes a website come up ______ in search engine results.
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Higher. SEO is the process by which a website comes up higher in search engine (such as Google) results.

mcqs.q: Which platforms are named in a digital marketing plan example?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Instagram, YouTube, website. The plan chooses which platforms to use for selling online.

mcqs.q: Content marketing is:
mcqs.why: Correct answer: A tool of digital marketing. It is listed with website designing, email marketing, social media marketing, online advertising, mobile apps and SEO.

mcqs.q: How is success measured in a digital marketing plan?
options: The plan itself decides how to measure success
mcqs.why: Correct answer: The plan itself decides how to measure success. Deciding the measure is one part of making the plan, along with goal, platforms, content and budget.

mcqs.q: Using words in your profile and bio on Instagram is done so that:
options: People searching for those words can find you easily
mcqs.why: Correct answer: People searching for those words can find you easily. Keywords in the profile and bio are an SEO technique for social media.

lessons.title: Payments and Safe Transactions
lessons.notes_html:
Online and Offline Payment Methods

KindMethodsPoints to remember
Offline methodsCash payment, credit cardsSimple, but cash can be lost and card information can be stolen
Online methodsDigital wallets, biometric verification, two-factor authentication (2FA), smart contractsFast and secure

A digital wallet (such as Google Pay) is a modern payment method in which money is paid through a mobile app.

Safe Transaction Method

A safe transaction method carries out transactions in a safe way and keeps personal data secure.

How to Choose a Safe Payment Method

  • Use a well-known and trusted platform.
  • Turn on 2FA (two-factor authentication).
  • Share your information with no one.
  • Check the receipt after payment.

mcqs.q: Which of the following is a modern payment method?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Digital wallet. A digital wallet (such as Google Pay) is a modern method in which money is paid through a mobile app.

mcqs.q: ______ carries out transactions in a safe way and keeps personal data secure.
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Safe Transaction Method. It carries out transactions safely and keeps personal data secure.

mcqs.q: In a digital wallet, money is paid through:
mcqs.why: Correct answer: A mobile app. Google Pay is the book's example of a digital wallet.

mcqs.q: Which pair lists OFFLINE payment methods?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Cash payment and credit cards. They are simple, but cash can be lost and card information can be stolen.

mcqs.q: Which pair lists ONLINE payment methods?
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Digital wallets and biometric verification. Online methods also include two-factor authentication (2FA) and smart contracts, and they are fast and secure.

mcqs.q: A risk of paying by cash is that:
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Cash can be lost. For credit cards, the risk is that card information can be stolen.

mcqs.q: To choose a safe payment method, you should:
options: Use a well-known and trusted platform and turn on 2FA
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Use a well-known and trusted platform and turn on 2FA. Also share your information with no one and check the receipt after payment.

mcqs.q: After making a payment, what should you do?
options: Share the receipt publicly with your password
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Check the receipt. Checking the receipt after payment is one of the safe-method steps in this lesson.

mcqs.q: Online payment methods are described in this lesson as:
mcqs.why: Correct answer: Fast and secure. Digital wallets, biometric verification, 2FA and smart contracts are the online methods.

mcqs.q: Why should you share your payment information with no one?
options: To keep your personal data secure during transactions
mcqs.why: Correct answer: To keep your personal data secure during transactions. A safe transaction method keeps personal data secure, and sharing information breaks that safety.
